# Operator Note: Machining Heat Treat Furnace #2 (MM-P2-L3-HT02)

Purpose
This note highlights critical operator actions and observations tied to the maintenance manual MM-P2-L3-HT02. It is intended to support safe, consistent daily checks and to capture anomalies for maintenance scheduling.

Pre-start checks
- Verify door seals and latch integrity visually; report any deformation or uneven seating.
- Confirm chamber clean of debris and coolant residue; remove foreign material before heat cycles.
- Ensure conveyor and fixtures move freely without binding or abnormal noise.

During operation
- Monitor process sounds and cycle consistency; note any intermittent clatter, scraping, or irregular motor loading.
- Watch control panel indicators for warning states and alarm messages; log any transient or persistent alerts.
- Check exhaust and ventilation flow at the intake/exhaust points for reduction or unusual odors.

Shutdown and post-cycle
- Allow controlled cool-down per procedure before unloading components.
- Inspect work area for scale buildup or spatter; perform localized cleaning to prevent transfer to downstream stations.
- Record furnace run details and observed deviations in the logbook referenced in MM-P2-L3-HT02.

Escalation and maintenance coordination
- Tag and isolate if safety interlocks fail, if structural components are compromised, or if repeated alarms occur.
- Report with descriptive symptoms, recent maintenance history, and any corrective actions taken to expedite troubleshooting.

Operator responsibility
Maintain clear, timely records and follow stop-work authority when safety or process integrity is in question.
